verbs.usage: peer add pull|remote|receive <name> [--host H] [--store S] [--namespace NS] [--port P] [--remote-namespace NS] [--max-depth N] [--schedule SPEC] [--group-filter F] [--auth-id ID] [--propagate] [--country CC] [--city C] [--building B] [--contact EMAIL] [--tunnel serve|dial] [--tunnel-net CIDR] [--listen-port P] [--endpoint H:P] [--peer-key K] [--mtu N] [--force]

options.description: peer add pull: the PBS we pull from.
peer add pull: its datastore name (default tappaas_backup).
peer add: pull/receive — where the data lands here. remote — what they may read (default: the root namespace, our VM backups).
peer add pull: its PBS API port (default 8007).
peer add pull: the namespace to pull FROM (default its root).
peer add pull: how many namespace levels below it to sync (0 = that namespace only; default all).
peer add pull: when to pull (default 04:00).
peer add pull: replicate only part of the source.
peer add remote: the login they pull with (we create it).
peer add remote: let the read grant reach child namespaces. Off by default — on the root that would expose fs/ (config + secrets) and other peers' data.
peer add: the country the peer's PBS is in (ISO code) — the evidence its copy is off-site (#609).
peer add: its city — needed to tell it apart from a Site in the same country.
peer add: its building or data centre — needed when it shares the Site's city.
peer add: the other site's operator — mailed by the pulse when their PBS stops answering (ADR-031).
peer add: carry this pull over its own WireGuard tunnel (#796, BUDDY.md). The pulled site serves (remote), the puller dials (pull).
peer add: the tunnel's /30. serve: default the next free /30 of zones.json buddy.ip (10.255.2.0/24). dial: the serving side's.
peer add remote --tunnel serve: UDP port to listen on (default the next free from 51830).
peer add pull --tunnel dial: the serving side's public address (or its satellite's) and port.
peer add: the other side's WireGuard public key. serve may add it later: re-run with --force.
peer add: tunnel MTU (e.g. 1340 through a satellite relay; default OPNsense's).
peer add: overwrite an existing peer config (keeps its tunnel /30 and port unless given).
peer add: write the config, skip onboarding (no PBS contact).
Config root (default: $CONFIG_DIR or /home/tappaas/config).
Machine output (JSON) for list/show/resolve/placement/peers.
Act on a different PBS (e.g. an off-site satellite) instead of this site's.

preview.touches: adds an off-site PBS relationship (a buddy, a remote, a receiver)

disruptions.consequence: peer add: overwrite an existing peer config (keeps its tunnel /30 and port unless given).
